build_online_feature_extractor: build an online speech feature extractor agent that converts audio waveforms to fbank features in a streaming fashion
create_feature_states: create feature states that track residual audio samples and target language for streaming feature extraction
run_feature_extraction_policy: run the feature extraction policy that reads audio segments and writes fbank feature outputs incrementally
add_cli_arguments: add command-line arguments for shift size, window size, feature dimension, and denormalize options to the agent
instantiate_from_args: instantiate the online feature extractor agent from parsed command-line arguments via from_args factory method
